statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and near-syncope
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Intermittent arrhythmia is suspected as the underlying etiology of these collapse events
The service is to capture rhythm data during symptomatic periods
The diagnosis codes are R55, I25.10, and I34.0
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
